name: token-watch
description: Plan usage and the context window as thin bars above the Claude Code prompt, with a prompt cache countdown and an opt-in keep-warm. Right-click to cycle its views; /context-bar hides it, or reads it as text where nothing draws.

snapshot.title: Usage snapshot file
snapshot.description: Write each reading to ~/.claude/token-watch/usage.json for Token Watch for VS Code. Local only; no other file is touched.
